study_identification_part.si4_title: Multimodal normative modeling in Alzheimer's Disease with introspective variational autoencoders

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Develop and evaluate a multimodal soft-introspective VAE (mmSIVAE) with Mixture-of-Product-of-Experts aggregation to improve normative modeling by better reconstructing healthy controls and detecting individual-level deviations in Alzheimer's disease using ADNI MRI and amyloid PET.

rci2_hc_n.reason: They explicitly report using 248 cognitively unimpaired controls to train the normative model.
rci2_hc_n.supporting_text: "For training, we selected 248 cognitively unimpaired (healthy control) subjects ..."

rci3_hc_age.answer: mean NR; sd NR; min NR; max NR
rci3_hc_age.reason: The paper does not report age statistics for the healthy control training cohort. Table S1 in the supplementary materials (media-3.docx.md) reports demographics for ADNI-CU (N=434, mean age 71.5±7.2) and ADRC-CU (N=301, mean age 68.2±7.3), but these appear to be separate holdout cohorts used for validation, not the 248 training healthy controls mentioned in the main text. The training cohort demographics are not explicitly reported.
rci3_hc_age.supporting_text: For training, we selected 248 cognitively unimpaired (healthy control) subjects from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging (ADNI) dataset... For model evaluation, we used 48 healthy controls for a separate holdout cohort...
rci3_hc_age.location: Kumar2024.pdf.md: Section 4.1 Data and feature preprocessing, lines 188-192

rci4_hc_sex.reason: Sex distribution is not reported for the 248 training healthy controls. Table S1 reports sex for ADNI-CU (N=434, M:F 205:229) but this is a different cohort than the 248 training subjects. The paper only states they conditioned on age and sex but does not report the sex distribution of the training cohort.
rci4_hc_sex.supporting_text: We conditioned our model on the age and sex of patients, represented as one-hot encoding vectors, to remove the effects of covariates from the MRI and PET features.
rci4_hc_sex.location: Kumar2024.pdf.md: Section 4.1 Data and feature preprocessing, lines 192-193

rci5_imaging_modality.reason: They modeled regional brain volumes from T1-weighted MRI and regional SUVR from AV45 amyloid PET as two modalities.
rci5_imaging_modality.supporting_text: "We used regional brain volumes extracted from T1-weighted MRI scans and regional Standardized Uptake Value Ratio (SUVR) values extracted from AV45 Amyloid PET scans as the two input modalities..."

nm1_model_origin.supporting_text: "we developed a multimodal introspective VAE ... Using multimodal neuroimaging biomarkers from the ADNI dataset..."

caa2_diseases_studied.reason: AD spectrum is explicitly stated as the target clinical cohort.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: mmSIVAE with MOPOE improved reconstruction of healthy controls and achieved stronger outlier detection (higher likelihood ratios) and clearer HC–ADS separation than baseline VAEs.
